verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Tailscale supports automation of the tailnet via infrastructure-as-code, webhooks, and integrations (implying an API/CLI layer), and a documented CLI exists, but there's no evidence of a comprehensive, documented API that mirrors all UI functionality — attempts to locate an OpenAPI spec returned 404s. Missing for 10: explicit API reference docs, confirmation of full UI-API parity, and independent verification that all admin/console actions are scriptable via API.
